source.title: Photo Requirements for Chinese Visa Application
source.publisher: The Department of Consular Affairs, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China

status_legend.verified: Stated in the MFA 2016 requirements sheet.
status_legend.provisional: Engineering threshold chosen by PhotoGen to evaluate a rule the sheet states qualitatively. Tunable; not an official number.

background.rule: White or close to white, with no borders around the edge of the image.

output.note: Largest size allowed by the sheet; any size from 354x472 to 420x560 is valid.

reference_frame.note: The sheet gives digital measurements 'with the digital photo of 354 x 472 pixels as an example'. They are scaled proportionally to the output size.

face_width.note: Body text states 205 px +/- 14 px. The diagram label reads '191 pixels - 251 pixels'; the body text is used.

chin_to_bottom.note: Face must be complete; the sheet sets no digital minimum.

head_height.note: Base of the chin to the crown of the head.

rules: Frontal view with the entire head and face clearly visible
Neutral expression, eyes open, mouth closed, ears visible
No visible distortion of facial features
No hand, toy or another person visible
Eyeglasses allowed only if lenses are not tinted and there is no glare, shadow or frame obscuring the eyes
Head coverings only for religious reasons and must not obscure facial features
No damage or impurities, no background light or shadow over the face, not over- or under-exposed
Face centered with all features visible and natural skin tone
Voluminous hair may be trimmed off at the top edge to keep the face at the required size
Photo taken within the last 6 months

policy.note: PhotoGen engineering thresholds. Not part of the MFA sheet.

crown.note: Calibrated on 40 public-domain portraits: silhouette/forehead ratio median 1.40 (p10 1.32, p90 1.46); bald subjects 1.24-1.29.
